diagram_previews.alt: Left: a vertical cross-section showing three circles of radius r, two resting on the ground line and one on top touching both, with dashed blue segments from the top centre to the two lower centres, a dashed segment between the lower centres and a red vertical segment from its midpoint to the top centre; a double arrow h on the right gives the height from the ground to the top of the upper circle. Right: the triangle of centres, with the two sides 2r in blue, the base split into two halves r sqrt 2, and the red altitude r sqrt 2 with a right-angle mark.
